populated.description: Shipping planted and ecology rosters with participating regional entities, scent and environmental sampling.

mixed-cadence-boundary.description: Populated regions at distinct admission cadences with entities crossing admission boundaries. Record cadence and boundary observations explicitly.

growing-frozen-history.description: Repeat the same active setup with increasing frozen history. Pin each history size separately; hold participating regions and their cadence fixed. Distinct history sizes are distinct workloads, not timing comparison pairs.
